content: Digettida Yeeho Wogata
Intte GODAA intte Xoossa nayta; hessa gishshas hayqqida asas mishettidi intte bolla qaaci madunththofte; intte hu7e binanakka buucofte.
Gaasoykka intte, GODAA intte Xoossaas dumma dere; GODAY biitta bolla diza dere ubbaafe intte izas dumma dere gidana mala izi inttena baas doorides.
Meetettizanne Meetettontta Medosata
Tuna gididaaz ay miishsheka moopite.
Hessa gishshas maana mala inttes imettida medosati hekko hayssafe kaalli dizayta; kacera dizaytappe miiz, dorsinne deysh,
genessa, doge, wusha, wora deysh, cofosho, gaara, cagonne bihore miite.
Qinccifilley phalqettidaytanne banchikizayta ubbaa miite.

Gido attiin qinccafilley phalqettonttaytanne banchikonttayta moopite; heytikka gaamella, harbaynonne guppale moopite; heytantta mala medosati banchikizaa gidikkoka istta qinccifilley muume gidida gishshas tuna gidi qoodetteettes.
Gudunththa qinccifilley phalqeth gidikkoka banchikontta gishshas izi hankko tunatara issife qoodettees; haytantta mala medosata moopitenne isttas ahakka bochchofte.
Haaththa giddon diza medheteththa ubbaafe qefera dizaytanne poqoy dizayta ubbaa miite.
Gido attiin haaththa giddon medheteththa ubbaafe qefeynne poqoy bayndayta moopite; heyti inttes tuna gidetto.
Kafotappe geeshshata miite.
Meetettanaas bessonttayti golle, qoollo, ankko,
dumma dumma xilotanne woleta,
dumma dumma quurota,
yanchcha, cancce gutto, haaththa kafo, gace zare ubbaa,
gutto, hazo, woyino
bazzo gutto, ankko, biya,
zigile, saabissa geetettiza haaththa kafo zare ubbaa, jinjilaate geetettiza kafonne wurkawurkko.
Qefera diza qeeri medheteththati ubbay inttes tuna gidida gishshas istta moopite.
Gido attiin istta giddofe geeshshata miite.

GODAA intte Xoossaas intte dummatida dere gidida gishshas bawuti hayqqida mehe asho moopite; hara dereppe yiidi intte giddon dizayti maana giikko diggofte; woykko hara dere asas bayzana dandayeeta. Deyshsha laaqqa iza aayey maaththan doyssofte.
Asraata Keso Woga
Intte layththan layththan goyidi demmiza kaththafe tammaafe issi kushe dumma shaakki woththite.

Intte ubba wode GODAA intte Xoossaa bonchcho taamarana mala izi ba sunththi xeygettana mala dooridason intte kaththaa, woyne ushshaanne zayte asraata, intte dorsatappenne mehetappe koyro yelettidayta GODAA intte Xoossaa sinththan miite.
GODAA intte Xoossay ba sunththi xeygettana mala dooridasozi intte dizasoppe keehi haaho gidikko GODAA Xoossay inttena anjjana mala intte intte asraataa he tookki ekkidi baanaas dandayontta ixxiko,
he intte kessida asraata bayzidi miishsheza GODAY dooridasoza miishshe ekkidi biite.

Histtidi heen he asraataa miishshaara intte koyida miish, miiz gidiin woykko dors, woyne ushshu gidiin woykko lo7o mino ushshu intte koyida mala shammidi intteso asa ubbaara mishe GODAA intte Xoossaa sinththan ufayettite.
Hessa intte ooththiza wode intte katamaan diza Lewe qommota gishan gakkida xinxxoy baynda gishshas intte istta yeggi aggofte.
Heedzdzanththo layththan layththan ubba wode intte kaththafe kessiza dumma asraata intte diza katamatan shiishshite.
Hessaka intte katamatan diza xinxxoy baynda Leweti, beteti, aaway baynda naytinne am7eti yiidi meto; intte hessaththo ooththizaa gidikko GODAA intte Xoossay intte ooso ubbaan inttena anjjana.

footnotes.text: -18 Haytanti ubbay hara kafota miza kafota.
